items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: a fella, his name was -- what was his name -- aw, Lord, I can't think of the fella's name that wrote a song for Buck and I called Adison Carey. He wrote a song called Buck and Bubbles.

ctx.x: Why were people trying to break the act up?

Because they wasn't no good. They saw the guy was taking advantage, that's what they saw. We never got what we deserved. No, uh-uh. We never put -- somebody be put that was worthwhile. We could have went in (whats'name. Look I got my voice cultivated. We could have went in Ripley's Believe It Or Not column. Look how many things we went in. We went in everything you could think of in the entertainment world. Ain't nothing you could think of we didn't go in. Believe me when I tell you. Everything. Go ahead, you…

theater in the City of Los Angeles, every theater in the City of Frisco, in London, every theater in Scotland and Glasgow, Edinburgh and every theatre in San Francisco, every theater in Philadelphia, Atlantic City, every cabaret you could think of that's worthwhile. You name it. Just think that over a while. You can't name no theater or no cafe that Buck and Bubbles haven't played in. Now that's a whole lot. What big show have Buck and Bubbles not played in, from the little show to the big show, we've been in all…
